name: 北森组织架构
description_zh: 查询组织架构与编制信息。支持查看部门详情（负责人、HRBP、分管领导、行政助理）、组织层级关系和编制占用情况。需管理者视角，助你洞悉团队全貌。
description_en: Query organizational structure and headcount info. View department details (manager, HRBP, reporting leader, admin assistant), org hierarchy, and headcount utilization. Manager-level access providing team visibility.
